scripts.format: prettier --check . && uv run --directory apps/server ruff format --check paperman tests scripts && uv run --directory apps/server ruff check paperman tests scripts
scripts.format:fix: prettier --write . && uv run --directory apps/server ruff format paperman tests scripts
scripts.typecheck: uv run --directory apps/server basedpyright && bun --filter @paperman/web typecheck
scripts.check: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.generate:api: uv run --project apps/server paperman schema && bun --filter @paperman/web generate:api
scripts.demo: uv run --project apps/server python apps/server/scripts/seed_demo.py && bun run demo:services
scripts.demo:api: PAPERMAN_DATA_DIR=.demo-data uv run --project apps/server paperman serve
scripts.demo:worker: PAPERMAN_DATA_DIR=.demo-data uv run --project apps/server paperman worker
